register.description: RF Core Power Management and Clock Enable

bitfield.description: Enable essential clocks for the RF Core interface - This includes: - Interconnect - Radio doorbell - DBELL command interface - Power management (PWR) clock control module - Bus clock (sclk) for the CPE To remove possibility of locking yourself out from the RF Core, this bit can not be cleared. If you need to disable all clocks to the RF Core, see the WLAN.WSOC register: ble_rfc_clken If you need to disable all clocks to the RF Core MDM, see the WLAN.WSOC register: ble_rfc_mdm_clken
Enable processor clock (hclk) to the Command and Packet Engine (mem_cpe_clken) As part of RF Core initialization, set this bit together with mem_cperam_clken to enable CPE to boot.
Enable clock to the Command and Packet Engine (CPE) RAM module. As part of RF Core initialization, set this bit together with CPE bit to enable CPE to boot.
Enable clock to the Modem (mem_mdm_clken) module.
Enable clock to the Modem RAM module (includes the MCE RAM).
Enable clock to the RF Engine (mem_rfe_clken) module.
Enable clock to the Radio Timer (RAT) module.
Enable clock to the Packet Handling Accelerator (PHA) module.
Enable clock to the RF Core Tracer (RFCTRC) module.
Software should not rely on the value of a reserved. Writing any other value than the reset value may result in undefined behavior.
MAIN Enable of the CPE Subsystem
MAIN Enable of the MDM Subsystem
MAIN BLE-TOP Enable

To force MOD_CLK to be exactly the same as MDM_CLK (as Agama Legacy) set this REG to '1'. MDM Modulator Clock (MOD_CLK) source is MDM_CLK. (controled by mem_mdm_clken). For power saving MOD_CLK Enabled when Modulator is Enabled by MCE REG: MDMENABLE.modulator. This REG - Cancel MOD_CLK power saving option.
Software should not rely on the value of a reserved. Writing any other value than the reset value may result in undefined behavior.

To force DEM_CLK to be exactly the same as MDM_CLK (as Agama Legacy) set this REG to '1'. MDM Demodulator Clock (DEM_CLK) source is MDM_CLK. (controled by mem_mdm_clken). For power saving DEM_CLK Enabled when Demodulator is Enabled by MCE REG: MDMENABLE.demodulator. This REG - Cancel DEM_CLK power saving option.

To force MCE REGBANK CLK to be exactly the same as MDM_CLK (as Agama Legacy) set this REG to '1'. Otherwise - for power saving MCE REGBANK CLK will be active only on WRITE Cycles. This REG - cancel MCE REGBANK CLK power saving option.

To force RFE REGBANK CLK to be exactly the same as MDM_CLK (as Agama Legacy) set this REG to '1'. Otherwise - for power saving RFE REGBANK CLK will be active only on WRITE Cycles. This REG - cancel RFE REGBANK CLK power saving option.
Disable AON Option to Force all CLKEN to '1' on power-up, by ble_aon_mem_clken_ovr (= ble_aon_general[0]). So CLK-EN will be directed controled by BLE_RFC_PWM_CLKEN Fields: MEM_*_CLKEN, as ecpected.
Software should not rely on the value of a reserved. Writing any other value than the reset value may result in undefined behavior.
Enable clock to the TOP Debug-Port module. This module sample the debug-port after the mux out.
